tasks.description: Create exactly 11 independent service directories under backend and initialize each service with its own pom.xml.

Configure Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, compatible Spring Cloud BOM, compiler settings, test dependencies, service ports, Eureka URL placeholders, and the exact MySQL/password properties in each applicable service application.properties.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_PASSWORD, EUREKA_CLIENT_SERVICEURL_DEFAULTZONE, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRATION_MS

tasks.description: Implement eureka-server using com.medicore.eureka.EurekaServerApplication, Eureka Server enablement, registry properties, resources, and smoke test.
Implement api-gateway with com.medicore.gateway.ApiGatewayApplication, GatewayRoutesConfig, CorrelationIdFilter, Eureka-backed routes for all domain services, resources, and smoke test.

Implement user-service entities, repository, RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, UserResponse, UserService, AuthController, UserController, and GlobalExceptionHandler with validated registration/login/profile behavior.
Implement user-service SecurityConfig, JwtService, and JwtAuthenticationFilter with externalized JWT settings, BCrypt PasswordEncoder, bearer authentication, and protected endpoint rules.
Add user-service smoke, UserServiceTest, and AuthControllerTest covering registration, duplicate email, BCrypt persistence, login JWT, validation, invalid JWT, and protected access.

Implement medicine-service complete manifest with Medicine entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, application properties, and tests for validated catalog behavior.

Implement prescription-service complete manifest with Prescription entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, application properties, and scalar cross-service IDs.
Add prescription-service smoke and service tests for valid creation, retrieval, status changes, scalar IDs, and validation failures.

Implement inventory-service InventoryItem entity, InventoryRepository with a pessimistic write lock query, request/response DTOs, InventoryService, controller, InsufficientStockException, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and tests.
Add inventory-service tests for successful reserve/release/adjust, invalid quantities, insufficient stock HTTP 409, rollback/no partial mutation, and nonnegative stock invariants.

Implement order-service Order and OrderItem entities with scalar medicine IDs, repository, request/response and inventory reservation DTOs, InventoryClient Feign interface, OrderService, OrderController, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and smoke test.
Add order-service tests mocking InventoryClient for successful reservation, inventory 409 propagation, downstream failure, validation, and order persistence behavior.
Implement payment-service complete manifest with Payment entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and real payment state transitions.

Implement fulfillment-service complete manifest with Fulfillment entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and real fulfillment state transitions.
Implement delivery-service complete manifest with Delivery entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and delivery tracking/status transitions.

Implement notification-service complete manifest with Notification entity, repository, request/response DTOs, service, controller, GlobalExceptionHandler, resources, and notification dispatch/state behavior.
Add payment, fulfillment, delivery, and notification smoke/service tests for creation, retrieval, valid transitions, invalid transitions, validation, and persistence boundaries.
Add consistent validation and exception JSON responses, actuator health settings, and logging-safe properties to every service without introducing cross-service JPA relationships.

Write backend/README.md with architecture, service responsibilities/ports, environment variables, MySQL setup, startup order, independent Maven run/test steps, JWT example, medicine/order/inventory examples, and HTTP 409 semantics.

Run mvn -q compile independently from eureka-server, api-gateway, user-service, medicine-service, inventory-service, order-service, prescription-service, payment-service, fulfillment-service, delivery-service, and notification-service; repair backend-only compile errors.
Run mvn -q test independently for all 11 service directories; repair failing backend tests and rerun until every service passes.
Verify every mandatory file in plan.md exists with real compiling implementation code and verify package declarations match paths.
Perform final scope/security checks: confirm created or modified paths are all under backend, exact JDBC URL is present, MYSQL_PASSWORD is externalized, and no hardcoded password exists.
